item.title: Grace 0.3.0
item.description:
Lighter and quieter.

  • Uses less than half the CPU while playing, and less again while the window is hidden.
  • No longer keeps the Mac awake while paused: the speaker is released after 10 seconds of silence.
  • The waveform shows progress by its played colour; the playhead line is gone. Played bars are darker in light mode.
  • Elapsed and remaining time change together, once a second.
  • Double-clicking a track always selects it.
  • Crossfade goes up to 4 seconds.
  • The crossfade arrow lines up with the waveforms, and the crossfade and volume values are a softer grey.
